review_route.rationale: Package and installation effects must never escape their confined authority root.

material_finding.summary: Ancestor validation is pathname-only, while later rename/remove effects follow a substituted symlink and can mutate outside the confined root before the post-check reports failure.
material_finding.result: A product-created stage pathname was renamed through a substituted ancestor; the outside escaped leaf existed afterward while the authorized original remained absent.

required_correction: hold trusted root and ancestor directory descriptors through the exact effect syscall
use descriptor-relative open, mkdir, rename, unlink, lock, stage, cleanup, and rollback operations
prove every outside tree remains byte-identical across root and ancestor substitutions
preserve exact JourneyBinding and zero-write observation behavior
verification_gap: The dependency-closed 76-test rerun was withheld after the decisive defect and ENOSPC stop.
highest_defensible_ceiling: Previously accepted offline/public distribution kernels only. The identity-ladder effect adapter remains unaccepted.
no_claim_statement: No live install, marketplace, cache, app-registry, Plugins UI, discovery, runtime, readiness, release, node closure, or goal completion is claimed.
